summary_en: Update to capital cost and stock price management framework previously disclosed July 2025. Current status analysis and future improvement initiatives reconfirmed.
title_en: Response to Capital Cost and Stock Price-Conscious Management—Update
translation_en_brief: On 23 June 2026, FUJI CO., LTD. (TSE Prime Market, code 8278) issued an update to its capital cost and stock price-conscious management framework. The disclosure confirms that management has conducted a reassessment of the company's current position and challenges since the framework was first disclosed on 23 July 2025. The update outlines revised initiatives and actions aimed at improving capital allocation and stock price performance going forward. Detailed content and specific metrics are contained in the attached supplementary material, which was not fully reproduced in this excerpt.
